section_summary.extract_value: This section details a hierarchical model examining the effects of achievement goals (PAP and MAP) and learning strategies (interest-based studying, vigilance, deep learning, surface learning) on exam performance. It reports standardized regression coefficients, indicating that PAP and MAP goals predicted higher exam grades, while interest-based studying and surface learning strategies predicted lower performance. An interaction effect between vigilance and instructional importance was also found.

section_summary.extract_value: This section details hierarchical regression analyses from Study 2, examining the links between achievement goals (MAP and PAP goals) and learning strategies with exam performance. It reports that students pursuing PAP goals and MAP goals earned high grades. Several learning strategies, including interest-based studying and vigilance, also predicted exam performance, with vigilance's effect qualified by an interaction with instructional importance accuracy. The results are presented in Table 6.
